notes.title: 🧸 Giant Problems Ahead: The Patapim Update Rolls Into Station
notes.notes:
🧸 Giant Problems Ahead: The Patapim Update Rolls Into Station

The BIGGEST update in THE LAST TRAIN: Baquedano history is approaching the platform, and it's bringing the legend of Patapim with it.



🗿 The giant awakens... and the mystery deepens

Something BIG is coming to THE LAST TRAIN: Baquedano – and we mean giant-sized big. The next update brings you face-to-face with the legend of Patapim, but this isn't just another stop on your journey. This is where the tracks lead to something much larger than expected.



🚂 New destination unlocked Explore a brand-new area with more puzzles and encounters with famous characters who know more than they're letting on. Each conversation could be the key to understanding what really happened in these forgotten halls.



🧸 The case of the missing Lebabe Plushies Where did they go? Why are they gone? And what does the haunting statue of BrrBrrPatapim have to do with their disappearance? Some mysteries are bigger than they appear, and this one might just change everything you thought you knew about the last station.



🏆 Three new achievements await the brave Only the most determined passengers will unlock all the secrets hidden within these ancient walls. Think you've mastered every corner of our world? Think again.



🎮 But that's not all... We've hidden extra surprises throughout the update – easter eggs, secret interactions, and hidden dialogues that only the most curious explorers will discover. Every shadow could hide a new secret, every corner might reveal something unexpected.



The giant statue watches, the plushies have vanished, and famous faces are ready to share their darkest secrets. The tracks have led you this far, but are you prepared for where they're taking you next?



The legend of Patapim isn't just a story – it's a warning.

Do you dare to board the last train once again? 🚇

notes.title: 🔧 Quality of life update
notes.notes:
🚇 Small but necessary adjustments

A quality of life update for THE LAST TRAIN: Baquedano is coming soon.
It’s a subtle patch, yes… but one that will make everything feel smoother.

Small but meaningful improvements, new interactions, and a few details you'll be glad we added.

🔍 Still working on something big

This patch is just one more step.
We’re working on a major content update that will expand the story, mechanics, and mysteries of the game.
We want returning to the station to be more unsettling… and unforgettable.

Thanks for staying on board.
And remember: leave a review if you've played!

notes.title: 🛠️ Small Patch, Big Improvements!
notes.notes:
🚇 Adjustments at the station

We’ve released a new patch for THE LAST TRAIN: Baquedano to fine-tune the experience.
Thanks for all your feedback, reports, and shared gameplays. We’re listening.


🛠️ Patch Notes:

Motion sickness adjustment option      

Drinking Energetics now speeds you up      

Localization bug fixes      

Simplified Chinese added as a game language  

📍 Thanks for staying on board

We’ll keep improving and expanding the game.
And as always... remember to get off before the last station.

notes.title: New shark update now available!
notes.notes:
🚨 Our biggest update so far

THE LAST TRAIN: Baquedano receives a major update today that completely changes the game experience.
We’ve worked to make the mystery more engaging and the gameplay longer.
It’s time to return to the station... because this time, there’s more to discover.

🦈 New canonical ending

You thought you understood it all. That the journey was over. But something has changed.

We’ve added new elements to deepen the game’s story. Our goal is to build a narrative that is both intriguing and entertaining.

And yes… one of your favorite characters returns to leave their mark.

🏆 Achievements are here!

Unlock every achievement by revisiting the decisions, paths, and horrors you may have missed the first time.

Replay value: guaranteed.

🥚 More easter eggs

New easter eggs are hidden for the most observant players.
Some offer clues, others are just… fun.

✍️ Leave your review

We invite you to replay THE LAST TRAIN: Baquedano and discover everything we’ve prepared.

Enjoyed the experience? Leave us a review on Steam — it really helps and gives the game more visibility.

--

The train is in motion. Are you sure you want to get back on?
Remember to get off before the last station.

notes.title: 🎉 Over 1,000 Copies Sold! A Big Update Is Coming
notes.notes:
Thank you for joining us on this journey! 

When we started working on THE LAST TRAIN: Baquedano, we were just 3 people with one idea: to make a short, intense, and terrifying game. No budget, no publisher—just the desire to tell an unsettling story that would linger in your mind.

Today, we can only express our deepest gratitude for the worldwide reception. We've now sold over 1,000 copies! We watch every gameplay, every comment, every reaction with a mix of joy and disbelief. Thank you for uploading your videos, sharing your theories, and getting scared with us. There’s nothing more rewarding than seeing something we made with love come to life on your screens.

🚇 Next station: a major update

We're already working on an update to expand and polish the experience. Here’s what’s coming:

🕯️ More story, more questions: We know some parts of the lore are confusing. We want the story to be as coherent as it is unsettling, planting mysteries we may explore in future updates.
🎮 Improved gameplay: Even though the game is simple, we can still refine and expand some mechanics. Community suggestions are already in development.
🌑 More immersive atmosphere: We’re improving the lighting and visual elements to make the experience even more intense and immersive.
🏆 Achievements! Yes, we love them too. The next update will include unlockable achievements based on your in-game actions.

Thank you for being here. Thank you for believing in this small indie project.

And remember... get off before the last station.
